ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.l1.injury_records.incident AS
SELECT COALESCE(concat('plant_a', ':', `establishment`, ':', `case_number`), '') AS record_key, 'plant_a' AS plant_group, 'plant_a.injury_log' AS source_table,
  `case_number` AS case_id, `establishment` AS site_code, date_format(to_date(`date_of_injury`, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS event_date, `part_of_body` AS body_part,
  concat_ws(' ', `what_happened`, `nature_of_injury`) AS narrative
FROM plant_a.injury_log
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(concat('plant_b', ':', `plant_id`, ':', `rec_id`), '') AS record_key, 'plant_b' AS plant_group, 'plant_b.inc_rpt' AS source_table,
  `rec_id` AS case_id, `plant_id` AS site_code, date_format(to_date(`inc_dt`, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS event_date, `body_pt` AS body_part,
  concat_ws(' ', `descr`, `inj_type`) AS narrative
FROM plant_b.inc_rpt
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(concat('plant_d', ':', `site`, ':', regexp_extract(`transcribed_text`, 'Case ([0-9A-Za-z_-]+)', 1)), '') AS record_key, 'plant_d' AS plant_group, 'plant_d.scanned_log_transcribed' AS source_table,
  regexp_extract(`transcribed_text`, 'Case ([0-9A-Za-z_-]+)', 1) AS case_id, `site` AS site_code, date_format(to_date(regexp_extract(`transcribed_text`, '([0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4})', 1), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS event_date, `transcribed_text` AS body_part,
  concat_ws(' ', `transcribed_text`) AS narrative
FROM plant_d.scanned_log_transcribed
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(concat('extra_sites', ':', `site`, ':', `case_no`), '') AS record_key, 'extra_sites' AS plant_group, 'extra_sites.injury_log' AS source_table,
  `case_no` AS case_id, `site` AS site_code, date_format(to_date(`injury_date`, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS event_date, `body_part` AS body_part,
  concat_ws(' ', `description`, `injury`) AS narrative
FROM extra_sites.injury_log
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(concat('plant_c', ':', `Site Name`, ':', `Case #`), '') AS record_key, 'plant_c' AS plant_group, 'plant_c.ehs_export_2024' AS source_table,
  `Case #` AS case_id, `Site Name` AS site_code, date_format(to_date(`Incident Date`, 'MM/dd/yy'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS event_date, `Body Part Affected` AS body_part,
